blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) is studying whether to file the complaint regarding the alleged misuse of up to P10 billion in funds for the 2019 Southeast Asian Games (SEA) in the Philippine SEA Games Organizing Committee (Phisgoc)’s hosting of the 2019 Southeast Asian (SEA) Games to the Department of Justice (DOJ) or the Office of the Ombudsman. NBI Director Melvin Matibag said the bureau already has enough evidence to file a case against individuals implicated in the supposed anomalies. “We can go to DOJ para magkaroon sila ng sariling investigation, or we can go directly and […]...
